title: Deductible Rewards Claim-Free Credit Administration Rule, Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**Administration rule.** Under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage each claim-free year earns one Deductible Rewards credit: the year credited runs from the period anchor and ends 12 months later, on the same day of the month, and a year whose end date has already been credited is never credited again. The period anchor is the end date of the latest credit entry on the coverage, or the payment date of the latest claim payment on the coverage when that is later. The annual credit is the option's Deductible Rewards annual credit, and the credit cap is the option's Deductible Rewards maximum credit. The claim-free credit is granted when at least 12 whole months have passed from the period anchor to the grant date; it is the annual credit reduced to the room left under the credit cap (the cap less the balance, never below zero), rounded to the cent; when fewer months have passed, no credit is granted. Credit is never paid in cash.

The end date of a credit entry is the last day of the period it credited; for the enrollment credit it is the enrollment date.

## Elements

| Element | Record or figure |
|---|---|
| Latest credit entry end date | The coverage's Deductible Rewards credit entries |
| Latest claim payment date | The coverage's claim payment history |
| Annual credit, credit cap | The deductible option's Deductible Rewards figures |
| Balance | The coverage's Deductible Rewards credit balance |
| Year credited | From the period anchor to the same day of the month 12 months later |

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates and figures; an option whose annual credit is 100 and maximum credit 500)

Latest credit entry ends 2025-04-10; no claim payment on the coverage after that date, so the period anchor is 2025-04-10.

| Grant date | Whole months since the anchor | Balance | Room under the cap | Credit granted | Year credited ends |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-04-12 | 12 | 200.00 | 300.00 | 100.00 | 2026-04-10 |
| 2026-04-12 | 12 | 450.00 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 2026-04-10 |
| 2026-04-12 | 12 | 500.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 2026-04-10 |
| 2026-04-09 | 11 | 200.00 | 300.00 | None | — |

If a claim payment on the coverage were dated 2025-07-01, later than 2025-04-10, the period anchor would be 2025-07-01 and the first grant date with 12 whole months would be 2026-07-01.
